novelty_points.claim: 提出一种结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型（Museformer），用于音乐生成；其中细粒度注意力使每个token直接关注与音乐结构最相关小节的所有token，粗粒度注意力使每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息而非每个具体token。
novelty_points.claim_en: We propose Museformer, a Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for music generation: with the fine-grained attention, a token directly attends to all the tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures; with the coarse-grained attention, a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them.
source_locations: 第三章 3.2.3 细-粗粒度注意力机制
technical_features: 结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型
细粒度注意力：每个token直接关注与音乐结构最相关小节的所有token
粗粒度注意力：每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息，而非每个具体token
该模型用于音乐生成任务
technical_features_en: A Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention
Fine-grained attention: a token directly attends to all the tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures
Coarse-grained attention: a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them

novelty_points.claim: 提出使用相似度统计的方法探究音乐结构，并据此确定结构相关小节（如之前的第1、2、4、8小节），作为细粒度注意力关注的目标。
novelty_points.claim_en: We propose to use similarity statistics to explore the structures of music, and based on the results determine the structure-related bars (e.g., the previous 1st, 2nd, 4th and 8th bars) that the fine-grained attention attends to.
source_locations: 第三章 3.3 音乐结构分析和结构相关小节选择
第三章 3.4 多轨音乐的相似度分布
technical_features: 使用相似度统计方法分析音乐结构
根据相似度统计结果确定结构相关小节
结构相关小节用于细粒度注意力的关注目标
选定的结构相关小节示例包括之前的第1、2、4、8小节
technical_features_en: Use similarity statistics to explore the structures of music
Determine the structure-related bars based on the results of similarity statistics
Structure-related bars are used as the focus of fine-grained attention
Examples of selected structure-related bars include the previous 1st, 2nd, 4th and 8th bars

novelty_points.claim: 利用区块稀疏（block-sparse）等技术实现细-粗粒度注意力（FC-Attention）的高效编码，使模型相较于原始Transformer具有更低的存储和计算复杂度，能够建模超过3倍长的音乐序列且具有更快的运行速度。
novelty_points.claim_en: We achieve efficient implementation of the fine- and coarse-grained attention (FC-Attention) with techniques such as block-sparse, enabling the model to have lower storage and computation complexity than vanilla Transformer, and to model over 3 times longer music sequences with a faster running speed.
source_locations: 第三章 3.5.3 FC-Attention 的高效实现
第四章 4.5 复杂度分析
technical_features: 使用区块稀疏（block-sparse）技术实现FC-Attention的高效编码
相较于原始Transformer具有更低的存储和计算复杂度
能够建模超过3倍长的音乐序列
technical_features_en: Efficient implementation of FC-Attention with techniques such as block-sparse
Lower storage and computation complexity than vanilla Transformer
Can model over 3 times longer music sequences
